android.desc:
Molfar is a free AI app: a chat assistant, experts with ready-made roles, and meetings where several AI models discuss your question at the same time. No subscriptions, no ads — connect your own API keys, and all chats, documents and files stay on your phone only.

SUPPORTED AI PROVIDERS • Google Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, OpenRouter, NVIDIA NIM. • Any OpenAI-compatible service — just add its address and key. • Keys are kept in encrypted Android Keystore storage. • You choose the models: separately for the chat, the expert and each meeting participant.

GAIDUK — YOUR ASSISTANT • Shows you how to use the app and talks about any topic. • Web search for up-to-date answers (on models that support it). • Add a PDF, DOCX, XLSX, text or photo to the chat — Gaiduk answers from the file and tells you where it found the answer. • Code, tables and Mermaid diagrams in answers appear as separate blocks with copy. • Chat history and export to .txt.

EXPERTS WITH ROLES • 28 ready-made roles: business, law, analytics, IT, sports and more. • Create your own roles — prompt and skill up to 10,000 characters each. • An expert helps you write or improve a role right in the editor.

AI MEETINGS — SEVERAL MODELS TOGETHER • Up to 4 expert participants, plus an Orchestrator and a Secretary. • All participants answer at the same time — no long waits. • The Orchestrator sums up the views, asks follow-up questions and builds a queue. • The Secretary keeps the minutes and answers questions about the meeting documents. • A shared document pool for all participants, web search for each one separately. • Conference and Arduino modes — for discussions and electronics projects. • Answers keep coming when you minimize the app.

EDITORS • Markdown: edit and preview, tables, Mermaid diagrams, print and PDF. • Document: open PDF, DOCX, XLSX, ODT or ODS, combine pages from different files into a new PDF, lay out a document from Markdown. • Images: zoom, rotate, crop, draw and mark up photos. • Unsaved changes are never lost — you come back right where you left off.

FILES • Built-in file manager with two tabs, grid view and thumbnails. • Import from your phone, Google Drive or via "Share". • Files are private: other apps and the gallery can't see them. They leave the app only when you tap "Save as" or "Open in another app".
